_about: The market facts of 5 November 2026 (6 Nov 2026 read). Single closing levels from the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED series, quoted with credit; the full series is NOT republished here (NASDAQCOM and NASDAQ100 are copyright Nasdaq, SP500 copyright S&P Dow Jones Indices, VIXCLS copyright Cboe). site/learn_tables.market_view() computes every change, drawdown and recovery gain from these levels; tests/test_selloff.py recomputes them a second way and asserts 11.90, 13.51, 14.72 and 17.25. The 'reported' block holds figures read in a news report, quoted with credit and not recomputed.
